answer: Think of Proof of unique cabin crew attestation with airline safety attestation as a toll booth: an attestation the airline renews after annual drills, so the lotus of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The cedar is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The timber is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
